Look.label: Look
Look.why: applies a ready look when it changes: presets carry the values instead
Look.hint: Applies a ready-made Textizo3D look and keeps your text.

FontMenu.label: Font
FontMenu.why: a menu that follows Font (its numbers depend on the computer's fonts)

StyleMenu.label: Style
StyleMenu.why: a menu that follows Style (its numbers depend on the computer's fonts)

FitToFrame.label: Fit to Frame
FitToFrame.hint: Shrinks a text too wide or tall for the frame so it stays inside, with a margin (a short text keeps its size).

MyLookName.label: Look Name
MyLookName.why: the name Save as My Look gives a look of the user's own (My Looks, 1.1); not part of a look
MyLookName.hint: The name your look gets in the Look menu and in Browse Looks.

T3InSync.label: On
T3InSync.hint: Words come in one at a time as Words Shown reaches them; the In rows play for each word from then.

T3InSyncWords.label: Words Shown
T3InSyncWords.hint: How many words show. Key it to the speech: 1 when the first word is said, 2 for the second ...

T3Ov1On.label: On
T3Ov1On.hint: Plays this row over the In and Out rows.

T3Ov1Prop.label: Property
T3Ov1Prop.hint: What this row animates. Size and Opacity multiply the rows above (1: as they are); Position, Rotation, Blur and Tracking add to them (0: as they are).

T3Ov2On.label: On
T3Ov2On.hint: Plays this row over the In and Out rows.

T3Ov2Prop.label: Property
T3Ov2Prop.hint: What this row animates. Size and Opacity multiply the rows above (1: as they are); Position, Rotation, Blur and Tracking add to them (0: as they are).

T3Ov3On.label: On
T3Ov3On.hint: Plays this row over the In and Out rows.

T3Ov3Prop.label: Property
T3Ov3Prop.hint: What this row animates. Size and Opacity multiply the rows above (1: as they are); Position, Rotation, Blur and Tracking add to them (0: as they are).

T3Ov4On.label: On
T3Ov4On.hint: Plays this row over the In and Out rows.

T3Ov4Prop.label: Property
T3Ov4Prop.hint: What this row animates. Size and Opacity multiply the rows above (1: as they are); Position, Rotation, Blur and Tracking add to them (0: as they are).

LinkColors.label: Link Colors
LinkColors.hint: On: the sides take the face's color. Off: the sides have a color of their own (Side Color).

FaceTexture.label: Face Texture
FaceTexture.hint: An image (PNG, JPG, TGA, BMP, HDR) multiplied into the face colour.

SideTexture.label: Side Texture
SideTexture.hint: An image multiplied into the side colour.

TexMapping.label: Texture Mapping
TexMapping.hint: How a face texture spans the letters.

TexScale.label: Texture Scale
TexScale.hint: Repeats of the texture across the mapped area.

FaceShader.label: Face Shader
FaceShader.hint: A Shadertoy-style GLSL file (mainImage) whose picture colours the faces.

SideShader.label: Side Shader
SideShader.hint: A Shadertoy-style GLSL file whose picture colours the sides.

EnvImage.label: Environment Image
EnvImage.hint: An equirectangular image (HDR or LDR) for the reflections, in place of the gradient and strips.

EnvShader.label: Environment Shader
EnvShader.hint: A Shadertoy-style GLSL file drawn as the environment (equirectangular).

T3FloatOn.label: Float
T3FloatOn.hint: The letters (or words, lines, the whole text) drift and sway gently, all through the clip.

T3FloatPieces.label: Float By
T3FloatPieces.hint: What floats as one piece: each letter, each word, each line, or the whole text.

T3FloatStyle.label: Float Style
T3FloatStyle.hint: Random: each piece keeps its own time. Wave: a wave runs through the text. Together: all in step.

T3FloatAmount.label: Float Amount
T3FloatAmount.hint: How far they drift: multiplies Float X, Y and Z (0: they only turn).

T3FloatRotation.label: Float Rotation
T3FloatRotation.hint: How much they turn: multiplies Float Rotation X, Y and Z (0: they only drift).

T3FloatSpeed.label: Float Speed
T3FloatSpeed.hint: How fast they float (1: a swing about every 3 seconds).

T3FloatX.label: Float X
T3FloatX.hint: Sideways, in % of a letter's height.

T3FloatY.label: Float Y
T3FloatY.hint: Up and down, in % of a letter's height.

T3FloatZ.label: Float Z
T3FloatZ.hint: Towards the camera and back, in % of a letter's height.

T3FloatRotX.label: Float Rotation X
T3FloatRotX.hint: Tipping forward and back, in degrees.

T3FloatRotY.label: Float Rotation Y
T3FloatRotY.hint: Turning left and right, in degrees (the sides catch the light).

T3FloatRotZ.label: Float Rotation Z
T3FloatRotZ.hint: Rocking side to side, in degrees.

T3FloatWave.label: Wave Length
T3FloatWave.hint: Wave styles: how many pieces one wave spans.

T3FloatPace.label: Pace Variation
T3FloatPace.hint: Random style: how differently the pieces keep time (0: all at one pace).

T3FloatRipple.label: Ripple
T3FloatRipple.hint: A quicker little wave on top of the swing (0: one smooth swing).

T3FloatEaseIn.label: Ease In (seconds)
T3FloatEaseIn.hint: The float grows from still over this time from the clip's start (0: floating from the first frame).

T3FloatSeed.label: Float Seed
T3FloatSeed.hint: Another random pattern for the same settings.

T3GlowFxOn.label: Glow
T3GlowFxOn.hint: A soft glow round the whole text, in its own colours or one colour.

T3GlowFxTextColors.label: Text's Colors
T3GlowFxTextColors.hint: On: the glow takes the letters' own colours. Off: Glow Color.

T3FireOn.label: Fire
T3FireOn.hint: Flames, embers and heat round the letters (light added over the picture).

T3FireInside.label: Inside the Letters
T3FireInside.hint: Keeps the fire within the letters' shapes.

T3FireFlames.label: Flames
T3FireFlames.hint: How strong the flames are (0: embers only).

T3FireEmbers.label: Embers
T3FireEmbers.hint: How many sparks fly off the letters.

T3FireDirection.label: Fire Direction
T3FireDirection.hint: The way the flames and embers go, in degrees: 90 up, 0 right, -90 down.

T3FireCenter.label: Center Effect
T3FireCenter.hint: Starts the fire at the middle of the text and sends the flames and embers out all round (Fire Direction is not used).

FireColor.label: Fire Color
FireColor.hint: The flames' main colour; their cores are hotter, their tips deeper.

T3FrostOn.label: Frost
T3FrostOn.hint: Cold mist and snow round the letters (light added over the picture).

T3FrostInside.label: Inside the Letters
T3FrostInside.hint: Keeps the mist and snow within the letters' shapes.

T3FrostMist.label: Mist
T3FrostMist.hint: How dense the mist off the letters is (0: snow only).

T3FrostHeight.label: Mist Reach
T3FrostHeight.hint: How far the mist and snow go.

T3FrostSnow.label: Snow
T3FrostSnow.hint: How many flakes drift off the letters.

T3FrostDirection.label: Frost Direction
T3FrostDirection.hint: The way the mist and snow go, in degrees: -90 down, 90 up.

T3FrostCenter.label: Center Effect
T3FrostCenter.hint: Starts the mist and snow at the middle of the text and sends them out all round (Frost Direction is not used).

T3SmokeOn.label: Smoke
T3SmokeOn.hint: Smoke drifting off the letters (it covers what is behind it).

T3SmokeInside.label: Inside the Letters
T3SmokeInside.hint: Keeps the smoke within the letters' shapes.

T3SmokeDirection.label: Smoke Direction
T3SmokeDirection.hint: The way the smoke drifts, in degrees: 90 up, 0 right.

T3SmokeCenter.label: Center Effect
T3SmokeCenter.hint: Starts the smoke at the middle of the text and sends it out all round (Smoke Direction is not used).

T3ElectricOn.label: Electric
T3ElectricOn.hint: Crackling electric arcs round the letters.

T3ElectricInside.label: Inside the Letters
T3ElectricInside.hint: Keeps the arcs within the letters' shapes.

T3ElectricReach.label: Arc Reach
T3ElectricReach.hint: How far the arcs jump from the letters.

T3RaysOn.label: Light Rays
T3RaysOn.hint: Rays of light streaming out from behind the letters.

T3RaysDirection.label: Ray Direction
T3RaysDirection.hint: The way the rays shine, in degrees: 90 up, 0 right, -90 down.

T3RaysCenter.label: Center Effect
T3RaysCenter.hint: The rays burst out from the middle of the text, all round (Ray Direction is not used).

T3ShineOn.label: Shine
T3ShineOn.hint: A band of light sweeping across the letters, again and again.

T3ShineEvery.label: Shine Every (seconds)
T3ShineEvery.hint: The time from one sweep to the next.

T3ShineDirection.label: Shine Direction
T3ShineDirection.hint: The way the band travels, in degrees: 0 left to right, 90 up.

T3ShineCenter.label: Center Effect
T3ShineCenter.hint: The shine starts at the middle of the text and splits in two, the bands running out to both ends along Shine Direction.

T3SparkleOn.label: Sparkles
T3SparkleOn.hint: Star glints twinkling on the letters.

T3GlitchOn.label: Glitch
T3GlitchOn.hint: Digital glitches: slices of the text jump and its colours split, now and then.

T3GlitchDirection.label: Glitch Direction
T3GlitchDirection.hint: The way the slices jump, in degrees: 0 sideways, 90 up and down.

T3DustOn.label: Dust
T3DustOn.hint: Fine dust drifting through the whole frame, some of it out of focus (light added over the picture).

T3DustDirection.label: Dust Direction
T3DustDirection.hint: The way the dust drifts, in degrees: 90 up, 0 right.

T3DustCenter.label: Center Effect
T3DustCenter.hint: The dust starts at the middle of the text and drifts out all round (Dust Direction is not used).

viewer_keys.what: Textizo3D's own keyframes of the text's transform (Position, Size, Rotation): the viewer's timeline
viewer_keys.frames: counted from the clip's first frame (0); one key a frame; the lines joined with \n in the node's text
viewer_keys.values: the text's transform at the key, in the units of the inputs PositionX ... RotationZ (Size a factor of the text's own size, rotations in degrees)
viewer_keys.ease: the curve of the way from this key to the next one (the last key's is not used)

custom.means: CSS cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2): time across, the way up; x1 and x2 from 0 to 1, y1 and y2 may overshoot (the viewer's curve editor: -0.6 to 1.6)

viewer_keys.base: an optional last line the viewer writes: the transform inputs' values when the keys took over. With it, those inputs move, size (by ratio) and turn the whole animation by their distance from it; without it (a node an AI writes) they leave the keys be
viewer_keys.spec: a kit spec's "keys": [{"frame": 0, "position": [x, y, z], "size": s, "rotation": [x, y, z], "ease": "out_back" or "cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)"}, ...] (and "keys_base"); fields left out are the node's; tools/textizo3d_preset.py keys <file.setting> reads a node's keys as that list

looks.name: Textizo3D-01A
looks.about: Sapphire: deep royal-blue glitter letters, navy sides, sharp highlights from a studio light; blurs in.

looks.name: Textizo3D-02A
looks.about: Ice: chunky letters of clear cyan ice, white caustics inside, a thick rounded bevel, cool bloom.

looks.name: Textizo3D-03A
looks.about: Lava: chunky lumpy letters of marbled molten lava, self-lit, a yellow edge glow, a deep rounded bevel.

looks.name: Textizo3D-04A
looks.about: Sky chrome: white chrome faces, the sky's blue in the chamfer and the sides, deep extrusion, low camera.

looks.name: Textizo3D-05A
looks.about: Gold: bright yellow-gold faces, darker brown-gold sides, a hard chamfer catching the light, low camera.

looks.name: Textizo3D-06A
looks.about: Carbon: woven carbon-fibre faces under a glossy clear coat, near-black sides, a thin red edge glow; blurs in.

looks.name: Textizo3D-07A
looks.about: Bubblegum: glossy hot-pink plastic, deep magenta sides, a soft pink bloom, rounded letters that pop in.

looks.name: Textizo3D-08A
looks.about: Camo: woodland camouflage printed on each letter, dark olive sides, matte, a warm key light; slams in.

looks.name: Textizo3D-09A
looks.about: Money, red: glossy red faces with a crisp white stroke, a red-brown extrusion.

looks.name: Textizo3D-10A
looks.about: Neon violet: rounded purple letters that glow, deep violet sides, a pink-violet edge glow and a purple bloom; blurs in.

looks.name: Textizo3D-11A
looks.about: Pearl puff: inflated italic letters, pearly white-blue faces, blue rims, white specular streaks.

looks.name: Textizo3D-12A
looks.about: Bandana: black paisley print on each letter, black sides, a fiery rim and fire light from below.

looks.name: Textizo3D-13A
looks.about: Leopard: leopard print on the faces, dark brown sides, fire light from below.

looks.name: Textizo3D-14A
looks.about: Fight poster: worn white print, a shallow dark-red extrusion, a red glow from below, a soft shadow behind.

looks.name: Textizo3D-15A
looks.about: Arena chrome: silver letters lit by a ring's red and blue lights, a red edge glow.

looks.name: Textizo3D-16A
looks.about: Money glow: bright green faces with fine light flecks, a deep extrusion with streaks seen from below, a thin light-green edge glow and a green bloom; high in the frame.
